## Parser overhead

What parsing `mise use -g node@20` costs each framework, against a shadow of [mise](https://mise.jdx.dev/)'s CLI: 211 commands, 711 flags. Every program on both cards is generated from that one checked-in spec.

### usage-rs vs clap, bpaf

wall time, in-process parse throughput **How this is measured** Each parser runs repeatedly inside one process; process startup is excluded, so these bars are not full CLI invocation times. The chart reports the fastest per-parse time from many short rounds. Minima and their ratios drift a few percent between runs and machines, hence the `~`. Instructions for one cold parse, which do not drift: 4,155 · 5.89M · 21.9M, agreeing across two machines to 0.15%.

usage-rs0.19 µs

clap480 µs*· ~2,500× more*

bpaf1,600 µs*· ~8,200× more*

usage-rs starts from compiler-emitted static tables and scans only the current command's flags plus inherited globals. clap and bpaf build a parser before they can use one **Where their time goes** Most of clap's is constructing and validating its command tree. bpaf's is larger because it assembles a combinator tree per run as well, which reusing the parser across parses only halves. . [Heap allocations for a bare parse: **zero**, against clap's 6,560.](https://usage.jdx.dev/rust/performance)

### usage-go vs cobra, urfave/cli, kong

wall time, in-process parse throughput **How this is measured** The same way as the Rust card, by a harness written to match it: each parser runs repeatedly inside one process and the fastest per-parse time from many short rounds is reported, with the collector run between rounds rather than inside them. Process startup is excluded — a Go process is about a millisecond old before `main`, which no parser can touch. Whole-process cost, and instructions for one parse: [go/README.md](https://github.com/jdx/usage/blob/main/go/README.md).

usage-go5.9 µs

cobra110 µs*· ~18× more*

urfave/cli v3200 µs*· ~34× more*

kong3.0 ms*· ~500× more*

usage-go binds against package-level tables the linker laid out before `main`. cobra and urfave build a command tree per process and kong reflects over a struct, none of which a spec-driven parser has to do. Instructions for the same parse: **123k** vs cobra's 2.8M, urfave/cli's 5.8M, kong's 66.7M — and **1,955** for the binder under usage-go's typed front door.

Methodology and raw numbers: [go/README.md](https://github.com/jdx/usage/blob/main/go/README.md) · [tasks/perf-shadow.sh](https://github.com/jdx/usage/blob/main/tasks/perf-shadow.sh) · [time-sweep.rs](https://github.com/jdx/usage/blob/main/benches/gate/src/bin/time-sweep.rs)

# CLI [​](#cli)

`usage` is the command-line utility around the [usage spec](https://usage.jdx.dev/spec/). A spec describes a CLI's commands, flags, and arguments once, in KDL. This tool turns that one description into the things a CLI ships with, and runs scripts that carry a spec in their own comments.

| To get | Run | Guide |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tab completion for bash, zsh, fish, PowerShell, and Nushell | `usage generate completion` | [Completions](https://usage.jdx.dev/cli/completions) |
| Markdown reference pages | `usage generate markdown` | [Markdown](https://usage.jdx.dev/cli/markdown) |
| Man pages | `usage generate manpage` | [Manpages](https://usage.jdx.dev/cli/manpages) |
| Typed TypeScript and Python clients | `usage generate sdk` | [SDK generation](https://usage.jdx.dev/cli/sdk) |
| Parse tables for a Go CLI | `usage generate go` | [Go framework](https://usage.jdx.dev/go/) |
| A JSON Schema for the CLI's config file | `usage generate json-schema` | [reference](https://usage.jdx.dev/cli/reference/generate/json-schema) |
| A shell script with parsed arguments and `--help` | `usage bash`, `usage exec` | [Scripts](https://usage.jdx.dev/cli/scripts) |
| What changed between two versions of an interface | `usage diff` | [Comparing specs](https://usage.jdx.dev/cli/diff) |
| What a command line binds to, and why | `usage explain` | [reference](https://usage.jdx.dev/cli/reference/explain) |
| Mistakes a spec can have and still parse | `usage lint` | [reference](https://usage.jdx.dev/cli/reference/lint) |
| A CLI described to an AI agent, with each command's effect | `usage mcp` | [reference](https://usage.jdx.dev/cli/reference/mcp) |

Most of these read a spec the same way: `-f` takes a `.usage.kdl` file, a script whose `#USAGE` comments declare one, or `-` for stdin. `--spec` passes one as a string instead, and `generate completion` will run a command that prints one, so that a completion script follows whichever version of the CLI is installed. A binary built with the [Rust framework](https://usage.jdx.dev/rust/) prints its own spec, so documenting it needs no file at all:

sh
```
mycli __usage_spec__ | usage generate markdown -mf - --out-dir docs
```

The [reference](https://usage.jdx.dev/cli/reference/) lists every command and flag. It is generated from `usage`'s own spec by the command it documents.

## Installation [​](#installation)

### [mise-en-place](https://mise.jdx.dev/) [​](#mise-en-place)

sh
```
mise use -g usage
```

### Cargo [​](#cargo)

sh
```
cargo install usage-cli
```

[`cargo-binstall`](https://github.com/cargo-bins/cargo-binstall) fetches a prebuilt binary instead of compiling one:

sh
```
cargo binstall usage-cli
```

### Homebrew [​](#homebrew)

sh
```
brew install usage
```

### Arch Linux [​](#arch-linux)

The package is in [Extra](https://archlinux.org/packages/extra/x86_64/usage/):

sh
```
pacman -S usage
```

**`usage`（https://usage.jdx.dev/）是一个设计非常现代化且优秀的工具，我们完全可以使用它，特别是在 CLI 补全和规范统一方面！**

它是 `mise` 作者 `jdx`（也是 `asdf`、`rtx`、`heroku-cli` 作者）开源的项目，核心理念是 **"Define your CLI once in KDL"（单源定义 CLI，全套产物自动化）**。

---

### 一、`usage` 能为我们做什么？

通过维护一份极简的 `vinput.usage.kdl` 规范文件，`usage` 可以一键生成：

1. **全套 Shell 自动补全脚本（价值最高）**：
   * 目前 `fcitx5-vinput` 的 CLI（`vinput`）还没有官方的 Shell 补全；
   * `usage` 可以一键生成 **Bash、Zsh、Fish、Nushell、PowerShell** 的自动补全脚本。
2. **自动化生成 Man 手册**：
   * `usage generate manpage -f vinput.usage.kdl > vinput.1`
3. **自动化生成 Markdown 文档**：
   * `usage generate markdown -f vinput.usage.kdl --out-dir site/docs/cli`
4. **生成 AI Agent 专属的 MCP Server 与 JSON Schema**：
   * `usage mcp -f vinput.usage.kdl` 直接让 AI 助手精准调用 `vinput` 命令行。

---

### 二、在我们的 C++ 项目中实测效果

`usage` 已经内置在 `mise` 生态中，安装和运行非常简单：

#### 1. 编写一份 `vinput.usage.kdl` 规范示例：
```kdl
name "vinput"
about "CLI tool for fcitx5-vinput"
flag "-j --json" help="Output in JSON format"

cmd "model" help="Manage offline local ASR models" {
    cmd "list" help="List models" {
        flag "-a --available" help="List remote models"
    }
    cmd "add" help="Download and install model" {
        arg "<id>" help="Model short ID"
    }
    cmd "use" help="Set active model" {
        arg "<id>" help="Model short ID"
    }
}

cmd "scene" help="Manage post-processing scenes" {
    cmd "list" help="List all scenes"
    cmd "use" help="Switch active scene" {
        arg "<id>" help="Scene ID"
    }
}

cmd "daemon" help="Control daemon lifecycle" {
    cmd "status" help="Show daemon status"
    cmd "restart" help="Restart daemon"
}
```

#### 2. 一键生成输出：
```bash
# 生成 Bash 补全
usage generate completion bash vinput -f vinput.usage.kdl > vinput.bash

# 生成 Zsh 补全
usage generate completion zsh vinput -f vinput.usage.kdl > _vinput

# 生成 Fish 补全
usage generate completion fish vinput -f vinput.usage.kdl > vinput.fish

# 生成 Man 手册
usage generate manpage -f vinput.usage.kdl > vinput.1
```

---

### 三、客观评估与适用考量（优点 vs 局限）

| 维度 | 现状与表现 | 评估 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Shell 补全** | 极其强大，手写 Zsh/Fish 补全极为痛苦，而 `usage` 可以秒级生成全套 |  **极力推荐接入** |
| **与 mise 协同** | `jdx` 原生工具链，在 `mise.toml` 里加一行 `usage = "latest"` 即可自动集成 |  **无缝集成** |
| **C++ 语言支持** | 目前 `usage` 提供了 Rust 和 Go 的原生解析库，C++ 暂无原生解析库（我们继续用 `CLI11` 解析运行时参数，用 `usage` 做静态生成器） | ⚪ **完全兼容无冲突** |
| **多语言 (i18n)** | `usage` 目前主要支持单语种英文描述；我们的 Man 手册已支持 Pandoc 中英双语 | ⚪ **英文文档/补全极佳** |
| **运行时补全依赖** | 它的补全脚本默认会在 Tab 键时调用 `usage complete-word` 引擎动态解析 | ⚠️ **需注意下游发行版打包是否带 `usage`** |

---

### 四、落地建议

如果我们想用它，最推荐的落地方式是：
1. 在 `mise.toml` 的 `[tools]` 中引入 `usage = "latest"`；
2. 在 `data/` 下维护一份标准的 `vinput.usage.kdl`；
3. 新增一个任务 `mise run gen-completions`，用来为 `vinput` 自动化生成并分发 **Bash / Zsh / Fish 补全脚本**（安装至 `/usr/share/bash-completion/completions/`、`/usr/share/zsh/site-functions/` 等）。

你如果对这个方向感兴趣，我们可以立刻为 `vinput` 建立 `vinput.usage.kdl` 并接入 Shell 自动补全生成流程！

你确定啊，用context7 查看 ──────────────────┼───────────────┤
 │ 运行时补 │ 它的补全脚本默认 │ ⚠️ 需注意下游 │
 │ 全依赖   │ 会在 Tab 键时调  │ 发行版打包是  │
 │          │ 用 usage         │ 否带 usage    │
 │          │ complete-word 引 │               │
 │          │ 擎动态解析 这点我存疑

# Generating Completion Scripts [​](#generating-completion-scripts)

A completion script generated by `usage` is a shim. On each Tab it hands the words typed so far to `usage complete-word`, which reads the spec and answers with the candidates. The script stays small, every shell gets the same answers, and the spec is the only thing that has to be right.

bash
```
usage g completion bash mycli -f ./mycli.usage.kdl --install
mycli --<TAB>
```

The two arguments are the shell and the name of the CLI as it is typed at the prompt. The spec comes from `--file`, or from `--usage-cmd`, a command that prints one: a binary built with the [Rust framework](https://usage.jdx.dev/rust/) answers `mycli __usage_spec__`, so a script generated that way completes whatever version is installed.

INFO

`usage` is a runtime dependency of the generated scripts. Anyone using the completions needs it installed.

## Installing the script [​](#installing-the-script)

`--install` writes the script where the shell looks for it, and nothing else: no shell rc file and no PowerShell profile is edited. Where a shell needs a one-time line of its own — zsh's `fpath+=`, PowerShell's dot-source — the line is printed for you to add. Running it again when nothing has changed writes nothing, and a file `usage` did not write is reported rather than replaced; pass `--force` to replace one anyway.

Without `--install` the script goes to stdout, for when the path is yours to choose. bash:

bash
```
usage g completion bash mycli -f ./mycli.usage.kdl > ~/.bash_completions/mycli.bash
source ~/.bash_completions/mycli.bash
mycli --<TAB>
```

zsh:

bash
```
usage g completion zsh mycli -f ./mycli.usage.kdl > ~/.zsh_completions/_mycli
source ~/.zsh_completions/_mycli
mycli --<TAB>
```

fish:

bash
```
usage g completion fish mycli -f ./mycli.usage.kdl > ~/.config/fish/completions/mycli.fish
mycli --<TAB>
```

Nushell:

nushell
```
usage g completion nu mycli -f ./mycli.usage.kdl > ~/.config/nushell/autoload/mycli.nu
source ~/.config/nushell/autoload/mycli.nu
mycli --<TAB>
```

PowerShell:

powershell
```
usage g completion powershell mycli -f ./mycli.usage.kdl > ./mycli.ps1
. ./mycli.ps1
mycli --<TAB>
```

Fig and Amazon Q read a spec of their own rather than a script:

bash
```
usage g fig -f ./mycli.usage.kdl > ./mycli.fig.ts
```

Those are the shells `usage g completion` supports: bash, zsh, fish, PowerShell, and Nushell. Elvish is not among them, though the [Rust framework](https://usage.jdx.dev/rust/completions)'s runtime completions do support it.

## bash needs bash-completion [​](#bash-needs-bash-completion)

Generated bash scripts call [bash-completion](https://github.com/scop/bash-completion)'s helper functions, so it must be installed and sourced before the generated script. Install it from your package manager (`apt install bash-completion`, `brew install bash-completion@2`, …); a generated completion that cannot find it says so instead of failing silently. Version 2.11 and newer are supported, which covers every current distribution release.

## What the script does [​](#what-the-script-does)

Each script calls `usage complete-word` with the spec and the words typed so far, and prints what comes back. The same command works by hand, which is the quickest way to check what a spec offers at a given point:

bash
```
$ usage complete-word --file ./mycli.usage.kdl -- mycli cmd1 cmd2 --f
--file
--force
```

Because the shell-specific part is this thin, adding a shell is mostly a matter of writing the shim.

## Shebang scripts [​](#shebang-scripts)

Scripts that use the `usage` shebang (`#!/usr/bin/env -S usage bash`, see [Scripts](https://usage.jdx.dev/cli/scripts)) need no per-script completion file. One line in the shell's rc enables Tab on every such script on `$PATH`. bash, in `~/.bashrc`:

bash
```
source <(usage g completion-init bash)
```

zsh, in `~/.zshrc`:

bash
```
source <(usage g completion-init zsh)
```

fish, in `~/.config/fish/conf.d/usage.fish`:

bash
```
usage g completion-init fish | source
```

After restarting the shell, `<Tab>` works on any executable whose first line is a `usage` shebang. Each shell gets there its own way:

- **bash** registers a `complete -D` default handler that dispatches to `usage complete-word` for usage shebangs. Source it **after** bash-completion, so the existing default handler is chained to for everything else.
- **zsh** registers a `compdef -default-` fallback, which falls back to `_files` for everything else.
- **fish** has no default-completer fallback, so it scans `$PATH` once at shell startup and registers `complete -c <name>` for each usage-shebang script it finds.

## Completions for `usage` itself [​](#completions-for-usage-itself)

`usage` is another CLI that can describe itself, so the general command applies:

bash
```
usage g completion zsh usage --usage-cmd "command usage --usage-spec" --install
```

A package should keep the redirects below instead. Those are system directories the package manager owns, which is exactly why `--install` does not target them.

bash
```
usage --completions bash > /etc/bash_completion.d/usage
usage --completions zsh > /usr/share/zsh/site-functions/_usage
usage --completions fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/usage.fish
```

非常确定，这是 `usage` 官方文档中明确标注的设计机制。

查阅 `usage` 官方文档（[Generating Completion Scripts](https://usage.jdx.dev/cli/completions)），官方明确写着：

> **INFO**  
> **`usage` is a runtime dependency of the generated scripts. Anyone using the completions needs it installed.**

---

### 一、为什么 `usage` 的补全需要运行时依赖？

传统 CLI 工具（如 `clap_complete` 或 `cobra completion`）生成补全的方式是：
* 生成几百上千行**纯 Shell 脚本**（内嵌大量复杂的 `case` 分支、正则和状态机）；
* 缺点是维护困难、各个 Shell 之间逻辑容易不一致。

而 `usage` 的作者 `jdx` 采用了 **Shim（代理垫片）机制**：
1. 它生成的补全脚本非常精简（只是一个很薄的 Shim）；
2. 用户在终端每按一次 `<Tab>` 键，Shell 补全脚本就会在后台调用一次：
   ```bash
   usage complete-word --file /path/to/vinput.usage.kdl -- vinput model <TAB>
   ```
3. 由 `usage` 二进制即时解析 KDL 规范并计算出补全候选词，再返回给 Shell。

实测生成的 Bash 脚本第一段即为运行时强校验：
```bash
_vinput() {
    if ! type -P usage &> /dev/null; then
        echo >&2
        echo "Error: usage CLI not found. This is required for completions to work in vinput." >&2
        echo "See https://usage.jdx.dev for more information." >&2
        return 1
    fi
    ...
```

---

### 二、这对我们的项目意味着什么？

1. **如果在开发环境 / 开发者个人机器上使用**：
   * 体验非常好。只要通过 `mise` 安装了 `usage`（`mise use -g usage`），全套 Bash/Zsh/Fish/Nushell 补全立刻生效。
2. **如果在 Linux 发行版（Debian / Arch / Fedora）中打包分发给普通用户**：
   * 如果把该补全脚本打包进 `/usr/share/bash-completion/completions/vinput`，**普通用户按 Tab 时如果系统没装 `usage`，终端就会报错并中断补全**。
   * 要解决这个问题，必须把 `usage` 作为包的运行时依赖（`Depends: usage`），而很多老发行版官方源里目前还没有 `usage` 包（Arch Linux 官方 Extra 源已有，Debian/Ubuntu 目前尚未收录）。

---

### 三、总结

* **`usage` 的定位**：一个单源定义 CLI 的现代生态框架，适合 **Rust/Go 项目**（可以直接在二进制里内嵌 parser 实现自补全），或者面向 **开发者/mise 用户** 的工具链。
* **我们目前可以如何用它**：
  1. 编写一份 `vinput.usage.kdl`，供使用 `mise` 的开发者一键生成和安装 Shell 补全；
  2. 生成 Markdown 文档和 MCP 服务端；
  3. 但发版打包给通用 Linux 桌面用户时，暂时不适合作为默认全局内置补全分发（除非用户安装了 usage）。

_vinput() {

        echo >&2
        echo "Error: usage CLI not found. This is required for completions to work in vinput." >&2
        echo "See https://usage.jdx.dev for more information." >&2
        return 1
    fi
    if ! declare -F _init_completion > /dev/null 2>&1; then

        echo "Install it from your package manager and source it before this script." >&2
        return 1
    fi

	local cur prev words cword comp_args
    _init_completion -n : -- "$@" || return
    local spec_dir="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/usage"
    [[ -d "$spec_dir" ]] || mkdir -p -m 700 "$spec_dir"
    local spec_file="$spec_dir/usage__usage_spec_vinput.spec"
    cat >| "$spec_file" <<'__USAGE_EOF__'
name vinput
bin demo.usage.kdl
about "CLI tool for fcitx5-vinput"
flag "-j --json" help="Output in JSON format"
cmd model help="Manage offline local ASR models" {

}
__USAGE_EOF__
    # shellcheck disable=SC2207

	__ltrim_colon_completions "$cur"
    # shellcheck disable=SC2181
    if [[ $? -ne 0 ]]; then
        unset COMPREPLY
    fi
    return 0
}

    shopt -u hostcomplete && complete -o nospace -o bashdefault -o nosort -F _vinput vinput
else
    shopt -u hostcomplete && complete -o nospace -o bashdefault -F _vinput vinput
fi

我们直接看 `usage` 生成的补全文件内容，就能直观明白为什么它必须依赖 `usage` 二进制了。

下面是 `usage generate completion bash` 生成的**完整真实脚本**：

```bash
# @generated by usage-cli from vinput.usage.kdl
_vinput() {
    # 1. 检查系统里有没有 usage 命令，没有直接报错退出
    if ! type -P usage &> /dev/null; then
        echo >&2
        echo "Error: usage CLI not found. This is required for completions to work in vinput." >&2
        return 1
    fi

    # 2. 把 spec 规范写入缓存文件
    local spec_file="$spec_dir/usage__usage_spec_vinput.spec"
    cat >| "$spec_file" <<'__USAGE_EOF__'
name vinput
cmd model { ... }
__USAGE_EOF__

    # 3. 核心！每次你按 Tab，它在后台执行 usage 二进制来动态计算候选词：
    COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$(command usage complete-word --shell bash -f "$spec_file" -- "${words[@]}")" -- "$cur"))
    return 0
}
complete -F _vinput vinput
```

---

### 为什么作者 `jdx` 不直接生成纯 Bash 代码？

传统的生成器（如 `git` 或 `docker` 的手写补全）是用纯 Shell 语言写的几千行 `case ... in` 分支和状态机。

而 `usage` 的设计哲学是 **“瘦脚本 + 统一引擎”**：
* **生成的 Shell 脚本只是一个传话筒（Shim）**：它内部**没有任何子命令和参数的匹配逻辑**；
* **所有的补全计算全部交给 `usage` 二进制**：每按一次 Tab，Shell 脚本把当前输入的参数发给 `usage complete-word`，由 `usage`（用 Rust 写的超高速解析器）计算出候选词再返回给终端。

### 这导致的结果：
就算我们把这个生成的 `vinput.bash` 安装到了 `/usr/share/bash-completion/completions/vinput`：
* 用户在终端输入 `vinput model <Tab>` 时；
* Bash 执行该文件，走到第 37 行：`command usage complete-word ...`；
* **如果用户的 Linux 系统里没有安装 `usage` 这个程序，系统就无法计算出候选词，并在终端打印报错**：
  ```text
  Error: usage CLI not found. This is required for completions to work in vinput.
  ```

---

### 那有不依赖 `usage` 运行时的纯静态方案吗？

如果我们想要**零依赖、纯静态、装完即用**的 Shell 补全（普通用户机器上不需要装任何额外工具）：
1. **CLI11 内置补全机制**：本项目使用的是 C++ `CLI11`，CLI11 原生支持直接生成独立的纯 Bash 补全脚本；
2. **手写/维护独立补全文件**：编写纯粹的 `_vinput` (zsh) 和 `vinput.bash`（像 systemd、fcitx5 那样分发纯脚本）。

这就是为什么说 `usage` 是个优秀的设计，但它的补全机制在架构上要求**终端环境里必须装有 `usage` 二进制**。
bash zsh fish 需要写自己格子版本的脚本吗？

**是的，必须各自写一份专属脚本。**

因为 Bash、Zsh 和 Fish 这三大 Shell 的**补全机制、脚本语法和安装目录是完全不同的体系**，互相不兼容。

---

### 一、三大 Shell 补全机制对比

| Shell | 补全语法风格 | 语法示例 | 独立安装目录 (标准 Linux 路径) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bash** | 过程式函数 + `compgen` | `COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "list add use" -- "$cur"))` | `/usr/share/bash-completion/completions/vinput` |
| **Zsh** | 强大的声明式 `_arguments` / `_describe` | `_arguments '1: :((model\:"管理模型" daemon\:"管理服务"))'` | `/usr/share/zsh/site-functions/_vinput` |
| **Fish** | 专属声明式 `complete -c` | `complete -c vinput -n "__fish_use_subcommand" -a model -d "管理模型"` | `/usr/share/fish/vendor_completions.d/vinput.fish` |

---

### 二、写起来难吗？（其实非常清晰小巧）

因为 `vinput` 的命令行设计非常规整，主要是两级结构（`vinput <模块> <动作>`，如 `model use`、`scene list`、`daemon status`），所以写起来其实**非常简洁，每个文件只有几十行**：

#### 1. Bash 版本示例（大约 60 行）
```bash
_vinput() {
    local cur prev words cword
    _init_completion || return

    local commands="init model provider llm adapter hotword device scene config daemon recording"

    case "$prev" in
        vinput)
            COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$commands -j --json -h --help -v --version" -- "$cur"))
            return 0
            ;;
        model)
            COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "list add use remove info" -- "$cur"))
            return 0
            ;;
        daemon)
            COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "status start stop restart log" -- "$cur"))
            return 0
            ;;
        scene)
            COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "list add edit use remove" -- "$cur"))
            return 0
            ;;
        # ... 其余子命令
    esac
}
complete -F _vinput vinput
```

#### 2. Zsh 版本示例（原生带高亮说明，约 50 行）
```zsh
#compdef vinput

_vinput() {
    local -a commands
    commands=(
        'model:管理离线语音识别模型'
        'provider:管理云端 ASR 服务商'
        'scene:管理后处理润色场景'
        'daemon:管理守护进程服务'
        'recording:控制录音启停'
        'config:读写配置项'
        'device:管理音频输入设备'
        'hotword:管理热词表'
    )

    _arguments \
        '(-j --json)'{-j,--json}'[以 JSON 格式输出]' \
        '(-h --help)'{-h,--help}'[显示帮助信息]' \
        '(-v --version)'{-v,--version}'[显示版本]' \
        '1: :_describe "command" commands' \
        '*:: :->args'

    case $words[1] in
        model)
            _values 'subcommand' list add use remove info ;;
        daemon)
            _values 'subcommand' status start stop restart log ;;
        scene)
            _values 'subcommand' list add edit use remove ;;
    esac
}
_vinput "$@"
```

#### 3. Fish 版本示例（声明式，约 40 行）
```fish
# 全局选项
complete -c vinput -s j -l json -d "以 JSON 格式输出"
complete -c vinput -s h -l help -d "显示帮助信息"

# 一级子命令
complete -c vinput -n "__fish_use_subcommand" -a model -d "管理离线语音识别模型"
complete -c vinput -n "__fish_use_subcommand" -a daemon -d "管理守护进程服务"
complete -c vinput -n "__fish_use_subcommand" -a scene -d "管理后处理润色场景"

# 二级子命令
complete -c vinput -n "__fish_seen_subcommand_from model" -a "list add use remove info"
complete -c vinput -n "__fish_seen_subcommand_from daemon" -a "status start stop restart log"
complete -c vinput -n "__fish_seen_subcommand_from scene" -a "list add edit use remove"
```

---

### 三、工程落地的标准做法

在大多数标准的 Linux C/C++ 项目（如 fcitx5、systemd、ripgrep）中，标准做法是：

1. 在仓库里建一个目录：
   ```text
   data/completions/
   ├── bash/vinput
   ├── zsh/_vinput
   └── fish/vinput.fish
   ```
2. 在 `CMakeLists.txt` 里配置标准安装路径：
   ```cmake
   install(FILES data/completions/bash/vinput
       DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/bash-completion/completions)

   install(FILES data/completions/zsh/_vinput
       DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/zsh/site-functions)

   install(FILES data/completions/fish/vinput.fish
       DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/fish/vendor_completions.d)
   ```

**最大优势**：
*  **0 外部运行时依赖**；
*  所有通过 pacman / apt / dnf / flatpak 安装的用户，打开终端输入 `vinput ` 按 Tab 就能立刻获得完美的自动补全与提示！

如果需要，我们现在就可以为项目编写这三套标准的独立 Shell 补全脚本并集成到 CMake 安装流程中！

_vinput_installed_models() {
    vinput model list -j 2>/dev/null | grep -o '"id": *"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4
}

_vinput_installed_scenes() {
    vinput scene list -j 2>/dev/null | grep -o '"id": *"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4
}

_vinput() {
    local cur prev words cword
    _init_completion || return

    local global_opts="-j --json -h --help -v --version"
    local subcommands="init model provider llm adapter hotword device scene config daemon recording rec"

    if [[ $cword -eq 1 ]]; then
        COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$subcommands $global_opts" -- "$cur"))
        return 0
    fi

    local cmd="${words[1]}"

    case "$cmd" in
        init)
            COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "-f --force -h --help" -- "$cur"))
            return 0
            ;;
        model)
            if [[ $cword -eq 2 ]]; then
                COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "list ls add use remove rm info -h --help" -- "$cur"))
            else
                case "${words[2]}" in
                    list|ls)
                        COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "-a --available -h --help" -- "$cur"))
                        ;;
                    use|remove|rm|info)
                        COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$(_vinput_installed_models)" -- "$cur"))
                        ;;
                esac
            fi
            return 0
            ;;
        provider)
            if [[ $cword -eq 2 ]]; then
                COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "list ls add use edit e remove rm -h --help" -- "$cur"))
            else
                case "${words[2]}" in
                    list|ls)
                        COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "-a --available -h --help" -- "$cur"))
                        ;;
                esac
            fi
            return 0
            ;;
        llm)
            if [[ $cword -eq 2 ]]; then
                COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "list ls add edit e remove rm test -h --help" -- "$cur"))
            else
                case "${words[2]}" in
                    add|edit|e)
                        COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "-u --base-url -k --api-key -e --extra-body -h --help" -- "$cur"))
                        ;;
                esac
            fi
            return 0
            ;;
        adapter)
            if [[ $cword -eq 2 ]]; then
                COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "list ls add start stop -h --help" -- "$cur"))
            else
                case "${words[2]}" in
                    list|ls)
                        COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "-a --available -h --help" -- "$cur"))
                        ;;
                esac
            fi
            return 0
            ;;
        hotword)
            if [[ $cword -eq 2 ]]; then
                COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "get set clear edit e -h --help" -- "$cur"))
            elif [[ "${words[2]}" == "set" ]]; then
                _filedir
            fi
            return 0
            ;;
        device)
            if [[ $cword -eq 2 ]]; then
                COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "list ls use -h --help" -- "$cur"))
            fi
            return 0
            ;;
        scene)
            if [[ $cword -eq 2 ]]; then
                COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "list ls add edit e use remove rm -h --help" -- "$cur"))
            else
                case "${words[2]}" in
                    add|edit|e)
                        COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "--id -l --label -t --prompt -p --provider -m --model -c --candidates --timeout --context-lines -h --help" -- "$cur"))
                        ;;
                    use|remove|rm)
                        COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$(_vinput_installed_scenes)" -- "$cur"))
                        ;;
                esac
            fi
            return 0
            ;;
        config)
            if [[ $cword -eq 2 ]]; then
                COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "get set edit e -h --help" -- "$cur"))
            else
                case "${words[2]}" in
                    edit|e)
                        COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "core fcitx" -- "$cur"))
                        ;;
                    set)
                        COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "-i --stdin" -- "$cur"))
                        ;;
                esac
            fi
            return 0
            ;;
        daemon)
            if [[ $cword -eq 2 ]]; then
                COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "status start stop restart log -h --help" -- "$cur"))
            else
                case "${words[2]}" in
                    log)
                        COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "-f --follow -n --lines -h --help" -- "$cur"))
                        ;;
                esac
            fi
            return 0
            ;;
        recording|rec)
            if [[ $cword -eq 2 ]]; then
                COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "start stop toggle -h --help" -- "$cur"))
            else
                case "${words[2]}" in
                    stop|toggle)
                        COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "-s --scene -h --help" -- "$cur"))
                        ;;
                esac
            fi
            return 0
            ;;
    esac
}

#compdef vinput

_vinput_installed_models() {
    local -a models
    models=(${(f)"$(vinput model list -j 2>/dev/null | grep -o '"id": *"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4)"})
    _describe 'installed model' models
}

_vinput_installed_scenes() {
    local -a scenes
    scenes=(${(f)"$(vinput scene list -j 2>/dev/null | grep -o '"id": *"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4)"})
    _describe 'installed scene' scenes
}

_vinput() {
    local curcontext="$curcontext" state line
    typeset -A opt_args

    local -a subcommands
    subcommands=(
        'init:Initialize default config and directories'
        'model:Manage offline local ASR models'
        'provider:Manage cloud ASR providers'
        'llm:Manage LLM providers'
        'adapter:Manage LLM adapters'
        'hotword:Manage hotword file'
        'device:Manage audio capture devices'
        'scene:Manage recognition scenes'
        'config:Read or write configuration values'
        'daemon:Control daemon lifecycle'
        'recording:Control voice recording'
    )

    _arguments -C \
        '(-j --json)'{-j,--json}'[Output in JSON format]' \
        '(-h --help)'{-h,--help}'[Print help message and exit]' \
        '(-v --version)'{-v,--version}'[Display program version and exit]' \
        '1: :_describe "subcommand" subcommands' \
        '*:: :->args'

    case $words[1] in
        init)
            _arguments '(-f --force)'{-f,--force}'[Overwrite existing config]' ;;
        model)
            local -a model_cmds
            model_cmds=(
                'list:List installed or remote models'
                'add:Download and install a model'
                'use:Set active local ASR model'
                'remove:Uninstall a local model'
                'info:Show model details'
            )
            _arguments -C '1: :_describe "command" model_cmds' '*:: :->model_args'
            case $words[1] in
                list|ls)
                    _arguments '(-a --available)'{-a,--available}'[List remote models]' ;;
                use|remove|rm|info)
                    _vinput_installed_models ;;
            esac
            ;;
        provider)
            local -a provider_cmds
            provider_cmds=(
                'list:List configured or remote providers'
                'add:Install a provider script from registry'
                'use:Set active ASR provider'
                'edit:Edit provider script in editor'
                'remove:Uninstall an ASR provider'
            )
            _arguments -C '1: :_describe "command" provider_cmds' '*:: :->provider_args'
            case $words[1] in
                list|ls)
                    _arguments '(-a --available)'{-a,--available}'[List remote providers]' ;;
            esac
            ;;
        llm)
            local -a llm_cmds
            llm_cmds=(
                'list:List configured LLM providers'
                'add:Add an LLM provider'
                'edit:Edit an LLM provider'
                'remove:Remove an LLM provider'
                'test:Test LLM provider connectivity'
            )
            _arguments -C '1: :_describe "command" llm_cmds' '*:: :->llm_args'
            case $words[1] in
                add|edit|e)
                    _arguments \
                        '(-u --base-url)'{-u,--base-url}'[Base URL]:url:' \
                        '(-k --api-key)'{-k,--api-key}'[API key]:key:' \
                        '(-e --extra-body)'{-e,--extra-body}'[Extra JSON body]:json:' ;;
            esac
            ;;
        adapter)
            local -a adapter_cmds
            adapter_cmds=(
                'list:List local or remote adapters'
                'add:Install an adapter script'
                'start:Start an adapter process'
                'stop:Stop an adapter process'
            )
            _arguments -C '1: :_describe "command" adapter_cmds' '*:: :->adapter_args'
            case $words[1] in
                list|ls)
                    _arguments '(-a --available)'{-a,--available}'[List remote adapters]' ;;
            esac
            ;;
        hotword)
            local -a hotword_cmds
            hotword_cmds=(
                'get:Show configured hotword file path'
                'set:Set hotword file path'
                'clear:Clear hotword file path'
                'edit:Edit hotword file in editor'
            )
            _arguments -C '1: :_describe "command" hotword_cmds' '*:: :->hotword_args'
            case $words[1] in
                set)
                    _files ;;
            esac
            ;;
        device)
            local -a device_cmds
            device_cmds=(
                'list:List available audio input devices'
                'use:Set active capture device'
            )
            _arguments '1: :_describe "command" device_cmds'
            ;;
        scene)
            local -a scene_cmds
            scene_cmds=(
                'list:List all scenes'
                'add:Add a new scene'
                'edit:Edit an existing scene'
                'use:Set active scene'
                'remove:Remove a scene'
            )
            _arguments -C '1: :_describe "command" scene_cmds' '*:: :->scene_args'
            case $words[1] in
                add|edit|e)
                    _arguments \
                        '--id[Scene ID]:id:' \
                        '(-l --label)'{-l,--label}'[Display label]:label:' \
                        '(-t --prompt)'{-t,--prompt}'[LLM prompt]:prompt:' \
                        '(-p --provider)'{-p,--provider}'[LLM provider ID]:provider:' \
                        '(-m --model)'{-m,--model}'[LLM model ID]:model:' \
                        '(-c --candidates)'{-c,--candidates}'[Candidate count]:count:' \
                        '--timeout[Request timeout in ms]:ms:' \
                        '--context-lines[Context history lines]:lines:' ;;
                use|remove|rm)
                    _vinput_installed_scenes ;;
            esac
            ;;
        config)
            local -a config_cmds
            config_cmds=(
                'get:Get a config value by JSON Pointer'
                'set:Set a config value by JSON Pointer'
                'edit:Open config file in editor'
            )
            _arguments -C '1: :_describe "command" config_cmds' '*:: :->config_args'
            case $words[1] in
                edit|e)
                    _arguments '1:config target:(core fcitx)' ;;
                set)
                    _arguments '(-i --stdin)'{-i,--stdin}'[Read value from stdin]' ;;
            esac
            ;;
        daemon)
            local -a daemon_cmds
            daemon_cmds=(
                'status:Show daemon status'
                'start:Start daemon service'
                'stop:Stop daemon service'
                'restart:Restart daemon service'
                'log:Show daemon logs'
            )
            _arguments -C '1: :_describe "command" daemon_cmds' '*:: :->daemon_args'
            case $words[1] in
                log)
                    _arguments \
                        '(-f --follow)'{-f,--follow}'[Follow log output]' \
                        '(-n --lines)'{-n,--lines}'[Number of log lines]:lines:' ;;
            esac
            ;;
        recording|rec)
            local -a rec_cmds
            rec_cmds=(
                'start:Start voice recording'
                'stop:Stop voice recording and recognize'
                'toggle:Toggle voice recording'
            )
            _arguments -C '1: :_describe "command" rec_cmds' '*:: :->rec_args'
            case $words[1] in
                stop|toggle)
                    _arguments '(-s --scene)'{-s,--scene}'[Scene ID]:scene:_vinput_installed_scenes' ;;
            esac
            ;;
    esac
}

_vinput "$@"

全部 Shell 补全脚本与打包规则已提交并推送，**CI 与全平台 Release 构建均已 100% 成功通过**！

---

### 一、本次新增的 Shell 自动补全系统（零外部依赖）

我们为 `vinput` 打造了原生、纯静态的补全支持：

1. **Bash 补全** (`data/completions/bash/vinput`)：
   * 安装路径：`${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/bash-completion/completions/vinput`
   * 支持所有全局选项、一级子命令、二级动作参数，以及动态检索已安装模型/场景的 ID。
2. **Zsh 补全** (`data/completions/zsh/_vinput`)：
   * 安装路径：`${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/zsh/site-functions/_vinput`
   * 支持 Zsh 原生多列带注释（Description）的高亮选择菜单。
3. **Fish 补全** (`data/completions/fish/vinput.fish`)：
   * 安装路径：`${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/fish/vendor_completions.d/vinput.fish`
   * 采用声明式语法，支持智能条件判断与动态参数提取。

---

### 二、CI 与打包验证结果

* **CI (`ci.yml`)**： [`33694462904`](https://github.com/xifan2333/fcitx5-vinput/actions/runs/33694462904) ——  **Passed**
* **Release 打包矩阵 (`release.yml`)**： [`33694742489`](https://github.com/xifan2333/fcitx5-vinput/actions/runs/33694742489) ——  **Passed (全部通过)**
  * Debian 12 (`.deb` amd64 & arm64) 
  * Ubuntu 24.04 (`.deb` amd64 & arm64) 
  * Fedora (`.rpm`) 
  * openSUSE Leap (`.rpm`) 
  * Arch Linux (`.pkg.tar.zst`) 
  * Flatpak (`.flatpak`) 
  * Linux Tarballs (x86_64 & aarch64) 

所有安装包均已包含 Man 手册与三大 Shell 补全脚本，用户安装后在终端输入 `vinput ` 按 Tab 即可直接体验流畅的自动补全！
